name: Broadleaf
title: Broadleaf SvelteKit Storefront — Svelte Commerce Connector
description: Svelte Commerce on Broadleaf Microservices: 28 of 43 services wired, with cart, checkout and sign-in. Setup, environment variables, limits and fixes.
lede: The Broadleaf connector targets Broadleaf Microservices — 41 OpenAPI 3.0.3 documents — not the legacy 5.x/6.x monolith, which publishes no versioned REST contract. Cart, checkout and sign-in are wired, and CONNECTORS.md records no gaps.
verdict: Cart, checkout and sign-in are wired, with no gaps recorded. One question is open with Broadleaf: its published `CartPricing` schema has no cart total, though its demo gateway returns one, so a deployment that follows the spec to the letter would show a total of zero.

quickStart.text: one connector at a time: remove the two the storefront ships with, add this one
point it at your Broadleaf gateway

env.name: PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_API_URL
env.note: Base URL of your Broadleaf Microservices gateway. Boot fails, naming this variable, if it is missing.

env.name: PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_API_KEY
env.note: OAuth client ID. With the secret, the connector requests a client-credentials token, which menu, customer and ratings calls need; catalogue browsing does not.

env.name: PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_API_SECRET
env.note: OAuth client secret, sent with the ID as HTTP Basic to `/oauth/token`. See the limitations before setting it.

env.name: PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.note: A bearer token to use instead; when one is set, the connector skips the client-credentials request.

env.name: PUBLIC_CONNECTOR
env.note: Only when more than one connector is installed: `@misiki/broadleaf-connector` names the one this build runs on.

envNote: `init.ts` hands the connector every `PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_*` variable that is set, camel-cased: `PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_STORE_ID` arrives as `storeId`. The guide also lists `PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_ACCESS_KEY`; the connector’s source does not read it.
backendSettings: Run Broadleaf Microservices. The connector is wired against its OpenAPI documents; the 5.x/6.x monolith publishes no versioned REST contract to wire against.
Create an OAuth client for the storefront if you want menus, customer and ratings calls: they need an application token, while catalogue browsing is anonymous.
howItWorks: The connector speaks Broadleaf Microservices’ REST APIs, as described by 41 OpenAPI 3.0.3 documents, and not the 5.x/6.x monolith. It takes a client-credentials token when it has an OAuth client ID and secret, and sends `tenantId` and `applicationId` from the channel and store variables.
limitations: No gaps are recorded for Broadleaf in CONNECTORS.md.

An open question on cart totals: Broadleaf’s published `CartPricing` schema has no `total`, `adjustmentsTotal` or `feesTotal`, but the demo gateway returns them. A deployment that follows the spec strictly would render a cart total of zero.
If you set `PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_API_SECRET`, the OAuth client secret reaches every visitor: SvelteKit sends `PUBLIC_` variables to the browser.

faq.q: Can I run a Broadleaf store on Svelte Commerce today?
faq.a: Cart, checkout and sign-in are wired against Broadleaf Microservices and no gaps are recorded, so it is one of the more complete connectors. Check your cart totals first: Broadleaf’s published schema omits them, and a gateway that follows it strictly would show zero.

faq.q: How do I switch Svelte Commerce to Broadleaf?
faq.a: Remove the connectors the storefront ships with, install `@misiki/broadleaf-connector`, set `PUBLIC_BROADLEAF_API_URL` in `.env` and start the dev server. `vite.config.ts` resolves whichever connector is installed, so no file in the storefront changes.

faq.q: Does the connector work with Broadleaf 5.x or 6.x?
faq.a: No. It targets Broadleaf Microservices, described by 41 OpenAPI 3.0.3 documents. The 5.x/6.x monolith publishes no versioned REST contract, so there was nothing to wire against.

openQuestion: `CartPricing` in the published schema has no `total`, `adjustmentsTotal` or `feesTotal`, but the demo gateway returns them. Which is authoritative?

api.surface: The connector calls the REST services of Broadleaf Microservices through one gateway, with no single base path: each service has its own context path, such as `/api/catalog-browse`, `/api/cart-operations`, `/api/order-operations`, `/api/customer` and `/api/payment`, and sign-in goes to `/auth`, which is not under `/api`.
api.auth: A shopper signs in with `POST /auth/embedded/login` (form-encoded `username` and `password`), which returns a one-time passcode that the connector exchanges at `POST /auth/oauth/token` (`grant_type=authorization_code`, `purpose=OTP`) for a bearer JWT and refresh token, held in the connector’s shared credentials; the `BLCART` and `BLSID` cookies Broadleaf sets are captured and sent back as a `Cookie` header during server rendering.

calls.what: `GET /api/catalog-browse/search/catalog` with `query`, `page`, `size` and `sort`, sent without a token; `GET /api/catalog-browse/products/details` with `productUris`, then `productIds`

`GET /api/catalog-browse/categories/details` with `categoryId` or `categoryUrl` and `hydrateProducts=false`; `GET /api/catalog/categories` and `/api/catalog/categories/subcategories` with a client-credentials token

`POST /api/cart-operations/cart` with the first item, `GET /cart/{cartId}`, `POST /cart/{cartId}/items`, `PATCH` or `DELETE /cart/{cartId}/items/{cartItemId}`, `POST /cart/{cartId}/pricing`, `POST` and `DELETE /cart/{cartId}/offer-codes`, and `GET /resolve-cart` for a signed-in shopper
`GET /api/order-operations/order-history` with `offset`, `size` and `sort=submitDate,desc`, `GET /order-history/{orderNumber}`, and `GET /api/cart-operations/cart-history` as a fallback
`GET`, `POST`, `PUT` and `DELETE` on `/api/customer/customers/{customerId}/addresses`, where the customer ID is the `serviceId` from `GET /auth/me`

rules: Every call carries an `X-Context-Request` header, a JSON object with `tenantId` and `applicationId`; without it Broadleaf’s catalogue search answers 400 `INVALID_SEARCH_REQUEST`.

Every cart write sends `X-Cart-Version` with the `version` from the last cart the connector read, because Broadleaf locks carts optimistically and answers 400 `CART_VERSION_REQUIRED` without it; the connector reads the cart first when it has not yet seen a version.

The `/checkout/*` routes answer 401 to an anonymous caller, so for a shopper who is not signed in the connector first requests an `X-Guest-Token` from `POST /checkout/{cartId}/guest-token` and sends it on each checkout call.

Broadleaf pages are numbered from 0 and only the numbered envelope carries `totalElements` and `totalPages`; the offset envelope used for categories, addresses and order history publishes no totals, so the connector reports them as 0 rather than counting the rows it received.

There is no route per payment provider: the connector reads the enabled `paymentMethodGatewayType` values from `payment-method-options`, creates a payment with `ownerType: 'BLC_CART'`, and throws `NotSupportedError` when the store has no matching gateway rather than guessing a path.
